你壮着胆子挡在了前面。大孩子们嘟囔了几句，走开了。你的心跳了好久才平下来。: You summoned your courage and stood in front. The big kids muttered a bit and walked off. It took your heart a long time to calm down.
你低头走开了。那天晚上，你在被窝里想了很久。: You put your head down and walked off. That night, you lay under the covers thinking for a long time.
家里人想让你学一样才艺，问你自己喜欢什么。: The family wants you to learn something, and asks what you'd like.
你开始学乐器，起初手指总不听使唤，半年后已经能弹一首完整的曲子。: You began learning an instrument. At first your fingers wouldn't obey you, and six months later you could play a whole piece.
你开始学画画，家里的墙上很快贴满了你的作品。: You began learning to draw, and the walls at home were soon covered with your work.
你说想多玩一会儿，大人们笑着答应了。: You said you wanted more time to play, and the adults laughed and agreed.
大人在院子边上给你留了一小块地，让你自己种点东西。: The adults set aside a little patch at the edge of the yard for you to grow something yourself.
学校发了几颗种子，让大家回家种在花盆里。: The school gave out some seeds for everyone to plant in pots at home.
向日葵长得比你还高，每天早上你都要去看看它朝着哪边。: The sunflower grew taller than you, and each morning you went to see which way it faced.
秋天你摘下了第一颗小番茄，分给家里每人一小口。: In autumn you picked your first little tomato, and gave everyone in the family a small bite.
{festival}快到了，大人问你最想要什么礼物。: {festival} is near, and the adults ask what present you want most.
你收到了一本厚厚的故事书，翻开第一页就舍不得放下。: You got a thick storybook, and couldn't put it down once you opened the first page.
你抱着新玩具睡了好几个晚上，连吃饭都要带着。: You slept with the new toy for several nights, and even brought it to meals.
那天全家人一起出门，你记住了每个人的笑脸。: The whole family went out that day, and you remembered everyone's smiling faces.
第一次试着封斋: Trying to fast for the first time
斋月到了，你想和大人们一样试着白天不吃东西。家里人说，量力而行就好。: Ramadan has come, and you want to try going without food by day as the adults do. The family says to do what you can.
试着坚持一整天: Try to last the whole day
你坚持到了日落，开斋时喝下的那口水，是你喝过最甜的。全家人都夸你长大了。: You lasted until sunset, and that first sip of water at dusk was the sweetest you'd ever had. The whole family said you'd grown up.
你坚持到了中午，大人笑着说：“明年再多坚持一会儿。”: You lasted until noon, and the adults laughed: "A little longer next year."
排灯节就要到了，家里人分配任务，问你想做什么。: Diwali is coming, and the family is handing out jobs. What do you want to do?
你小心地把一盏盏油灯摆在窗台上，夜里整条街都亮了起来。: You carefully set out lamp after lamp on the windowsill, and at night the whole street lit up.
你和伙伴们在巷子里放烟花，笑声比烟花还响。: You and your friends let off fireworks in the lane, and your laughter was louder than the fireworks.
发烧了还想上学: Feverish but wanting to go to school
你发烧了，可明天学校有你期待了很久的活动。: You have a fever, but tomorrow the school has an event you've looked forward to for ages.
你乖乖在家睡了一天，烧退了，第二天又活蹦乱跳。: You stayed home and slept all day. The fever broke, and you were bouncing around again the next day.
你硬撑着去了学校，回家后又烧了起来，多躺了两天。: You dragged yourself to school. The fever came back at home, and you spent two more days in bed.
放学路上，一只瘦瘦的小猫跟着你走了很远。: On the way home from school, a skinny little kitten follows you for a long way.
你抱着小猫回家，求了大人好久。小猫留了下来，名字叫{petname}。: You carried the kitten home and begged the adults for ages. It stayed, and its name was {petname}.
你把面包掰碎喂给它，第二天放学，它又在老地方等你。: You crumbled some bread for it. The next day after school, it was waiting in the same spot.
图书馆可以给小朋友办借书证了。: The library now gives cards to children.
每个周末你都会去图书馆，借回一摞书，再在约定的日子还回去。: Every weekend you went to the library, borrowed a stack of books, and brought them back on the agreed day.
你偶尔去一次，专挑有很多图画的书。: You went now and then, picking the books with lots of pictures.
{granny}又要讲她年轻时候的故事了，可伙伴们正在门外喊你。: {granny} is about to tell stories of her youth again, but your friends are calling you from outside.
你搬了个小板凳坐在她身边，听她讲那些很久以前的事。很多年后，你还记得她讲故事时的: You brought a little stool, sat beside her, and heard about those long-ago things. Many years later, you still remembered how she looked telling them.
你答应她明天再听，一溜烟跑了出去。: You promised to listen tomorrow, and shot out the door.
你和{sibling}都想玩同一个玩具，眼看就要吵起来了。: You and {sibling} both want the same toy, and a fight is about to start.
你把玩具让了出去。{sibling}愣了一下，晚上把自己的点心分了你一半。: You gave up the toy. {sibling} looked surprised, and shared half their snack with you that night.
你们定好每人玩一会儿，还用沙漏计时。: You agreed that each would play for a while, timing it with an hourglass.
去找大人告状: Tell on them to an adult
大人把玩具收走了，谁也没玩成。: The adult took the toy away, and no one got to play.
夏天到了，家里人觉得你该学会游泳了。: It's summer, and the family thinks it's time you learned to swim.
你从抱着浮板发抖，到能一口气游完一个来回，只用了一个夏天。: You went from shivering on a float to swimming a full lap in one breath, all in one summer.
你在浅水区扑腾了一个夏天，学会了憋气。: You splashed about in the shallows all summer, and learned to hold your breath.
科学课的作业是在家做一个小实验。: Your science homework is to do a small experiment at home.
小苏打和醋一碰，泡沫“噗”地涌了出来，你兴奋得叫了起来。: Baking soda met vinegar and the foam came whooshing out, and you shouted with excitement.
你趴在地上看了一个星期蚂蚁搬家，记了满满三页笔记。: You lay on the ground watching ants move house for a week, and filled three pages of notes.
学校停课了，老师在屏幕那头讲课，屏幕这头只有你一个人。: School has closed. The teacher talks on one side of the screen, and on the other side there's only you.
你每天准时坐到屏幕前，笔记记得比在教室里还认真。: You sat down at the screen on time each day, and took better notes than in the classroom.
你把老师的画面缩到角落，偷偷玩起了游戏。期末考试时你有点慌。: You shrank the teacher's window to a corner and secretly played games. You panicked a little at exam time.
学校给每个孩子配了一个 AI 学习伙伴，它什么问题都能回答。: The school gives each child an AI study partner, which can answer any question.
你每天都要问它十几个“为什么”，它从不嫌烦。你的问题越问越深。: You asked it a dozen "why"s each day, and it never got tired. Your questions went deeper and deeper.
你更喜欢举手问老师，老师总会多讲一些书上没有的东西。: You preferred raising your hand to ask the teacher, who always told you more than the book did.
家里答应送你一只“小狗”，可以选会说话的机器狗，也可以去领养一只真的。: The family has promised you a "puppy". You can choose a talking robot dog, or adopt a real one.
机器狗会背古诗、会讲笑话，还从来不掉毛。: The robot dog could recite poems and tell jokes, and never shed a hair.
你们从救助站领回一只小狗，取名{petname}。它咬坏了你一只拖鞋，你一点也不: You brought a puppy home from the shelter and named it {petname}. It chewed up one of your slippers, and you weren't mad at all.
今天是赶集的日子，大人要去集上卖东西。: Today is market day, and the adults are going to sell things.
你帮大人吆喝、找零，算账比大人还快，收摊时得了一块糖。: You helped the adults call out to customers and give change, did sums faster than they did, and got a sweet when you packed up.
你在集上逛了一整天，看耍把戏的、卖小鸡的，样样都新鲜。: You wandered the market all day, watching the performers and the chick sellers, and all of it was new.
去学校要走很远的路，天不亮就得出门。: School is a long walk away, and you have to set off before dawn.
你们一路说说笑笑，远路好像也没那么远了。: You chatted and laughed along the way, and the long road didn't seem so long.
你一边走一边背课文，到学校时已经背得滚瓜烂熟。: You recited your lessons as you walked, and knew them by heart when you got there.
你的生日快到了，家里人问你想怎么过。: Your birthday is coming, and the family asks how you want to spend it.
同学们挤满了客厅，你吹蜡烛时许了一个谁也没告诉的愿望。: Classmates filled the living room, and as you blew out the candles you made a wish you told no one.
一家人围在一起吃了顿好的，你收到了一个大大的拥抱。: The family gathered for a good meal, and you got a big hug.
长大想做什么: What to be when you grow up
老师让大家写一篇作文：《长大以后》。: The teacher has everyone write an essay: "When I Grow Up".
你写想当科学家，造一艘能飞到星星上的飞船。: You wrote that you wanted to be a scientist, and build a ship that could fly to the stars.
你写想当医生，让生病的人都快点好起来。: You wrote that you wanted to be a doctor, and make all sick people better soon.
你写想开一家小店，卖全世界最好吃的点心。: You wrote that you wanted to open a little shop, selling the tastiest snacks in the world.
中秋节到了，家里买了一盒月饼，你最先挑。: It's the Mid-Autumn Festival, the family bought a box of mooncakes, and you get to pick first.
你挑走了最喜欢的那一块，咬一口，满嘴都是甜。: You took your favourite, and one bite filled your mouth with sweetness.
你把盒子先递给了爷爷奶奶。大人们夸你懂事，你也很开心。: You passed the box to your grandparents first. The adults praised you, and you felt happy too.
学校要排一出节日小话剧，老师问你想演什么。: The school is putting on a little holiday play, and the teacher asks what you want to play.
你背了一个星期的台词，上台时一句也没忘，台下的家长们都在鼓掌。: You learned your lines for a week and didn't forget one on stage, and the parents all clapped.
你演一棵树，从头站到尾，偷偷朝台下的家人眨眼睛。: You played a tree, standing from start to finish, and secretly winked at your family in the audience.
你学会了骑车，想和伙伴们骑去城边的河边。: You've learned to ride a bike, and want to cycle with your friends to the river at the edge of town.
你告诉了大人路线和回家时间，痛痛快快地玩了一下午。: You told the adults your route and when you'd be back, and had a wonderful afternoon.
你在院子里一圈一圈地骑，练会了单手扶车把。: You rode round and round the yard, and learned to steer with one hand.
你认识的字越来越多，开始能自己读完一本小书了。: You know more and more words, and can read a little book by yourself.
你每天睡前读上几页，书架上的书慢慢多了起来。: You read a few pages before bed each day, and the bookshelf slowly filled up.
让大人读给你听: Have an adult read to you
你还是喜欢窝在大人怀里听故事。: You still liked curling up in an adult's arms to hear a story.
老师发了彩笔，让大家画一画自己最想要的东西。: The teacher hands out coloured pens, and asks everyone to draw what they want most.
你画了一座有院子的房子，门口站着你和家人。老师把它贴在了墙上。: You drew a house with a yard, with you and your family standing at the door. The teacher put it on the wall.
你画了一所很大的学校，窗户里的每个孩子都在笑。: You drew a huge school, with a smiling child at every window.
家里同意给你买手机，但要先“约法三章”。: The family has agreed to buy you a phone, but first wants to set some rules.
答应晚上交手机: Agree to hand it in at night
你答应每晚十点把手机交给大人。一开始很不习惯，后来睡得反而更好了。: You agreed to hand your phone to the adults at ten each night. It was strange at first, and later you slept better for it.
保证不耽误学习: Promise it won't affect your studies
你拍着胸脯保证不耽误学习，期末成绩也确实没掉。: You swore it wouldn't affect your studies, and your end-of-term marks didn't drop.
你说再等等，先把心思放在学习上。: You said you'd wait, and keep your mind on your studies first.
课后，几个朋友躲在墙角抽烟，有人递了一根给你。: After class, a few friends are smoking in a corner, and someone hands you one.
你学着他们的样子吸了一口，呛得直咳嗽，大家都笑了。从那以后，你口袋里常常揣着一包: You copied them and took a puff, coughing and choking, and everyone laughed. From then on, you often had a pack in your pocket.
你笑着摆摆手：“我不抽。”没有人再劝你。: You smiled and waved your hand: "I don't smoke." No one pressed you.
学校的社团开始招新，海报贴满了走廊。: School clubs are recruiting, and posters fill the corridors.
你加入了{sport}队，每天放学后训练，身上晒出了印子，也交到了一群好兄弟好姐: You joined the {sport} team and trained after school each day. You got a tan line and a great bunch of teammates.
你加入了文学社，第一次把自己写的诗印在了校刊上。: You joined the literature club, and for the first time saw a poem of yours printed in the school magazine.
你加入了编程社，写出第一个能动的小程序时，你在机房里叫出了声。: You joined the programming club. When your first little program moved, you shouted out loud in the computer room.
你发现自己总会不由自主地看向班上的一个人。: You find your eyes keep drifting to someone in your class.
你写了一张小纸条，又改了七八遍。对方回了一个笑脸，你高兴了一整天。: You wrote a little note and changed it seven or eight times. They answered with a smiley face, and you were happy all day.
你把这份心动藏在日记里，很多年后翻到，还会笑出声来。: You hid the crush in your diary. Coming across it many years later, you still laughed out loud.
把心思放回学习: Put your mind back on studying
你深吸一口气，把心思拉回了课本上。: You took a deep breath and pulled your mind back to your textbook.
暑假到了，你想找点事情做。家里人问你的打算。: It's the summer holidays and you want something to do. The family asks about your plans.
你在一家小店打了一个暑假的工，第一次知道挣钱有多不容易。: You worked at a little shop all summer, and learned for the first time how hard it is to earn money.
你报了补习班，暑假和上学一样忙。: You signed up for tutoring, and the holidays were as busy as term time.
你睡到自然醒，看完了一直想看的几本书。: You slept until you woke, and read those books you'd always wanted to read.
周末，朋友们约你一起通宵打游戏。: At the weekend, friends invite you to game all night.
你们一直玩到天亮，第二天你睡到了下午，晚上又睡不着。: You played until dawn, slept until the next afternoon, and then couldn't sleep at night.
你十一点准时下线，朋友们笑你“养生”，你也跟着笑。: You logged off at eleven sharp. Your friends laughed at you for being so health-conscious, and you laughed along.
{exam}越来越近，班上好多同学都在上补习班。: {exam} is getting closer, and many classmates are in tutoring.
你每天放学后再去补习班，回家时街上的灯都亮了。成绩往前挪了一截，人也瘦了一圈。: You went to tutoring after school each day, and the street lights were on by the time you got home. Your marks moved up, and you got thinner.
你给自己定了复习计划，一项一项地划掉。: You made a revision plan and crossed things off one by one.
你和几个同学结成学习小组，互相出题、互相打气。: You formed a study group with a few classmates, setting each other questions and cheering each other on.
学校号召大家利用周末去做志愿服务。: The school urges everyone to volunteer at weekends.
你陪养老院的老人们聊天、读报，一位奶奶记住了你的名字，每次都拉着你的手。: You talked with the residents and read them the paper. One old woman remembered your name, and always took your hand.
你在图书馆把一排排书摆整齐，顺便发现了好几本想读的书。: You lined up rows of books at the library, and found several you wanted to read.
为了一件小事，你和家里大人吵了起来，摔门进了房间。: Over something small, you argued with the adults and slammed your bedroom door.
你在门口站了很久，终于开口说了声“对不起”。大人眼圈红了，说他们也有不对。: You stood at the door for a long time, and finally said "sorry". The adult's eyes reddened, and they said they'd been wrong too.
冷战几天: Don't speak for a few days
你们冷战了好几天，最后在饭桌上若无其事地和好了。: You didn't speak for days, and finally made up at the dinner table as if nothing had happened.
你把想说的话写在纸上，悄悄放在他们的枕头边。第二天早餐桌上，多了一个你爱吃的煎蛋: You wrote what you wanted to say on paper and quietly left it by their pillow. At breakfast the next day, there was an extra fried egg, just how you like it.
你想换个发型，在镜子前比画了好久。: You want a new hairstyle, and spend ages trying things in the mirror.
新发型让你在学校里引起了小小的轰动，你假装不在意，心里却有点得意。: The new hairstyle caused a small stir at school. You pretended not to care, and felt rather pleased.
你最后还是剪了老样子，舒服就好。: In the end you got the same old cut. Comfortable is good.
同学们都在网上分享生活，你也想开个账号。: Your classmates all share their lives online, and you want an account too.
开一个记录生活: Open one to record your life
你开始在网上记录日常，偶尔收到几个陌生人的点赞，也收到过让你难过的评论。: You began recording your days online. Sometimes strangers liked your posts, and sometimes comments hurt you.
你觉得那里太吵，还是更喜欢面对面说话。: You thought it was too noisy, and still preferred talking face to face.
一到晚上，你就忍不住刷短视频，一刷就停不下来。: At night, you can't resist short videos, and can't stop once you start.
你给自己设了半小时的提醒，时间一到就放下手机。: You set yourself a half-hour reminder, and put the phone down when it rang.
你常常刷到凌晨，第二天上课眼皮直打架。: You often scrolled until the small hours, and your eyelids drooped in class the next day.
同学们都在用 AI 写作文，你也打开了对话框。: Your classmates are all using AI to write essays, and you open the chat box too.
只用它查资料: Only use it to look things up
你让 AI 帮你找资料、挑错别字，文章还是自己一个字一个字写的。: You had AI find material and spot typos, and wrote the essay yourself word by word.
作文很快交上去了，可考试时你对着题目发了半天呆。: The essay went in fast, but in the exam you stared blankly at the question for a long time.
你坚持自己写，熬了几个晚上，写出来的东西却是自己的。: You insisted on writing it yourself. It took a few late nights, but what you wrote was your own.
学校组织春游，要自己找同伴分组。: The school is holding a spring outing, and you have to form your own groups.
你们一路说笑，拍了一大堆傻乎乎的照片。: You chatted and laughed the whole way, and took a pile of silly photos.
你和几个不太熟的同学分到一组，一天下来，多了几个新朋友。: You ended up with a few classmates you barely knew, and by the end of the day you had a few new friends.
饭钱怎么用: How to use your lunch money
家里每周给你一点饭钱，你可以自己安排。: The family gives you a little lunch money each week, for you to manage.
你每天少吃一份零食，月底给自己买了一本想了很久的书。: You skipped a snack each day, and at the end of the month bought a book you'd long wanted.
你和同学们一起去学校门口的小店，边吃边聊，一天里最快乐的就是这一会儿。: You went to the little shop by the school gate with your classmates, eating and talking. It was the happiest part of the day.
体育老师说，坚持晨跑一个学期，体能会大不一样。: The PE teacher says that if you keep up morning runs for a term, your fitness will be very different.
你每天早上跑三公里，从气喘吁吁到越跑越轻松。: You ran three kilometres every morning, going from gasping to running easily.
你周末和朋友们打球，跑得满头大汗。: You played ball with friends at weekends, running until you were dripping with sweat.
老师以为是你在课上捣乱，当着全班批评了你。: The teacher thought you were the one messing about in class, and scolded you in front of everyone.
下课后你去办公室把事情说清楚，老师向你道了歉。: After class you went to the office and explained, and the teacher apologised to you.
算了，忍着: Forget it, put up with it
你憋着一口气没说话，回家后一个人生了半天闷气。: You held it in and said nothing, and sulked by yourself for ages at home.
学校选拔学生参加竞赛，老师觉得你可以试试。: The school is selecting students for a competition, and the teacher thinks you could try.

Over half of countries and territories are already below 2.1, and nearly a fifth below 1.4 ("ultra-low fertility").

People over 80 grow from about 160 million to about 450 million in 2050, and those over 65 are expected to outnumber under-18s in the late 2070s.

China is expected at about 1.26 billion in 2050, 740 million in 2090 and 630 million in 2100, with about 31% over 65 in 2050. South Korea is at about 25.4 million in 2090, and Japan about 80.6 million.
最新统计：中国 2025 年出生人口约 792 万、死亡约 1131 万，年末总: Latest figures: China had about 7.92 million births and 11.31 million deaths in 2025, with a year-end population of about 1.405 billion, its fourth straight fall, and about 23% over 60. South Korea had about 254,000 births in 2025, with the total fertility rate back up to about 0.80. Japan had 671,236 newborn Japanese nationals in 2025 and a total fertility rate of 1.14, both record lows.

It assumes net foreign inflow of about 164,000 a year by 2040.

Pakistan is expected to grow from about 251 million to about 372 million in 2050 and about 499 million in 2090. Bangladesh peaks around 2071 (about 226 million).
基于 UN WPP 2024 中方案：撒哈拉以南非洲人口预计从 2024 年约: From the UN WPP 2024 medium variant: Sub-Saharan Africa is expected to grow from about 1.24 billion in 2024 to about 2.09 billion in 2050 and about 3.19 billion in 2090, rising from 15.2% of world population to about 31% in 2090, and from about 31% to about 43% of world births. Nigeria is expected to grow from about 233 million to about 359 million in 2050 and about 472 million in 2090, and DR Congo from about 109 million to about 399 million in 2090.

The US is expected to grow from about 345 million to about 415 million in 2090, mainly through international migration (estimated 2024 net inflow of about 1.29 million against natural growth of about 610,000), with natural growth expected to turn negative in the early 2040s. Latin America and the Caribbean peak around 2053 (about 731 million).
联合国经社部估计 2024 年年中全球国际移民约 3.04 亿人，约占世界人口: UN DESA estimated about 304 million international migrants worldwide in mid-2024, about 3.7% of world population (about 154 million in 1990). UNHCR counted about 117.8 million forcibly displaced people worldwide at the end of 2025, the first fall in a decade (123.2 million in 2024).
联合国《世界城镇化展望 2025》（采用新的统一地理空间口径）：全球约 45%: UN World Urbanization Prospects 2025 (using a new uniform geospatial measure): about 45% of people live in cities. Megacities of over 10 million grew from 8 in 1975 to 33 in 2025, 19 of them in Asia. Jakarta (about 42 million) is now the most populous, and Dhaka is expected to become the largest around 2050. On the old measure (WUP 2018), the urban share is expected to be about 68% in 2050, with India, China and Nigeria adding about 35% of urban growth from 2018 to 2050.
IMF《世界经济展望》（2026 年 10 月）：全球经济增长 2025 年约: IMF World Economic Outlook (October 2026): global growth was about 3.5% in 2025, forecast at 3.1% in 2026 and 3.4% in 2027. Advanced economies are at 2.1% in 2026 and 1.8% in 2027, and emerging and developing economies at 3.7% and 4.4%. Global inflation is forecast to rise from 4.1% in 2025 to 4.7% in 2026, mainly from the energy price shock of the Middle East conflict. The US is at about 2.3% in 2026, China about 4.5% (4.0% in 2027) and India about 7.0%.
长期增长趋缓：世界银行《长期增长前景下滑》报告估计 2022—2030 年全球潜: Slowing long-run growth: the World Bank's Falling Long-Term Growth Prospects estimates global potential growth at about 2.2% a year from 2022 to 2030, the lowest in thirty years, with developing economies falling from about 6% in 2000–2010 to about 4%. In the OECD's 2018 long-term baseline, global real GDP growth may slow from about 3.5% to about 2% by 2060.
高盛 2022 年《通往 2075 之路》长期预测：全球增长将放缓但新兴市场追赶: Goldman Sachs's 2022 long-term forecast "The Path to 2075": global growth slows but emerging markets keep catching up. China, the US and India may remain the top three economies, and populous countries such as Indonesia, Nigeria, Pakistan and Egypt may rise near the top. The IMF (October 2026 Asia-Pacific outlook) expects India's nominal GDP to pass Japan's in 2027, becoming the world's fourth-largest economy.
债务压力：IMF《财政监测报告》称全球公共债务 2025 年约为 GDP 的 9: Debt pressure: the IMF's Fiscal Monitor puts global public debt at about 94% of GDP in 2025, nearing 100% by 2029. The long-term outlook from the US Congressional Budget Office (CBO) in early 2026 shows federal debt held by the public rising from about 99% in fiscal 2025 to 108% in 2030, 129% in 2040 and about 175% in 2056, with net interest passing Social Security spending around 2047.
美国社会保障 2026 年受托人报告：老年与遗属保险（OASI）信托基金预计在: The 2026 US Social Security Trustees Report: the Old-Age and Survivors Insurance (OASI) trust fund is expected to run out in the fourth quarter of 2032, when continuing income could pay about 78% of scheduled benefits. OASI and Disability Insurance combined run out around the third quarter of 2034, paying about 83%. The 75-year actuarial deficit is 4.42% of taxable payroll.
贫困：世界银行 2025 年把国际极端贫困线上调至每天 3.00 美元（2021: Poverty: in 2025 the World Bank raised the international extreme poverty line to US$3.00 a day (2021 PPP), estimating about 808 million people (9.9%) in extreme poverty in 2025, with sub-Saharan Africa's share expected to rise from about 69% to about 73%. On the earlier US$2.15 measure, its 2024 report expected about 622 million (7.3%) still in extreme poverty in 2030, making the goal of ending it by 2030 almost out of reach.
不平等：《世界不平等报告 2026》显示，全球收入最高的 10% 人口获得约 5: Inequality: the World Inequality Report 2026 shows the top 10% of earners worldwide get about 53% of income and hold about three quarters of wealth, while the bottom 50% get only about 8% of income and hold about 2% of wealth.
就业：国际劳工组织《就业和社会趋势 2026》预计 2026 年全球失业率约 4: Jobs: the ILO's World Employment and Social Outlook 2026 forecasts global unemployment of about 4.9% in 2026 (about 186 million), with about 2.1 billion informal workers, the share highest in Africa and South Asia. Improvement in job quality has stalled.
劳动年龄人口格局转移：世界银行估计到 2050 年撒哈拉以南非洲将新增约 6.2: The shifting working-age population: the World Bank estimates sub-Saharan Africa will add about 625 million working-age people by 2050, over three quarters of the global rise, while East Asia and the Pacific lose over 200 million. The IMF estimates about half of new global labour market entrants by 2030 will come from sub-Saharan Africa, which may need up to about 15 million new jobs a year.
退休年龄普遍上调：中国自 2025 年 1 月起用 15 年时间将男职工法定退休: Retirement ages rising widely: China from January 2025 will raise the legal age over 15 years from 60 to 63 for men and from 50/55 to 55/58 for women, with the minimum pension contribution period rising by half a year annually from 15 to 20 years from 2030. Denmark legislated in 2025 to raise the state pension age to 68 in 2030, 69 in 2035 and 70 in 2040. Singapore raised its retirement/re-employment ages to 64/69 in July 2026, planning 65/70 by 2030. Vietnam reaches 62 for men in 2028 and 60 for women in 2035. Germany's legal age rises to 67 by 2031.
养老金改革进展：韩国 2025 年修订《国民年金法》，自 2026 年起缴费率每: Pension reform progress: South Korea's 2025 National Pension Act raises contributions by 0.5 points a year from 2026, from 9% to 13% in 2033, sets a nominal replacement rate of 43%, and delays the fund's depletion from 2056 to 2064 (2071 on optimistic assumptions). France's 2026 social security financing act suspends the 2023 retirement age rise until 2028. Britain's state pension age rises from 66 to 67 in 2026–2028. Russia completes its move to 65 for men and 60 for women in 2028.
观测：世界气象组织（WMO）报告 2024 年为有记录以来最暖年份，全球平均气温: Observations: the World Meteorological Organization (WMO) reports 2024 as the warmest year on record, about 1.55°C above pre-industrial (1850–1900), the first single year above 1.5°C. 2025 was about 1.43°C above, the second or third warmest, and 2015–2025 are the 11 warmest years on record.
WMO 与英国气象局 2026 年 5 月年度至十年气候预测：2026—2030: The WMO and UK Met Office's May 2026 annual-to-decadal climate update: a chance of about 91% that at least one year from 2026 to 2030 exceeds 1.5°C above pre-industrial, about 75% that the five-year average does, and about 86% that at least one year beats the 2024 record. Annual temperatures are expected at 1.3–1.9°C above pre-industrial.
升温路径：联合国环境署《排放差距报告 2025》估计，按现行政策本世纪升温约 2: Warming pathways: UNEP's Emissions Gap Report 2025 estimates about 2.8°C of warming this century under current policies, about 2.3–2.5°C with national pledges fully met, and about 1.9°C with all net-zero pledges too. In the IEA's World Energy Outlook 2025, the Current Policies Scenario nears 3°C by 2100, the Stated Policies Scenario reaches about 2.5°C, and the Net Zero Scenario peaks at about 1.65°C around 2050.
IPCC 第六次评估报告：2081—2100 年相对 1850—1900 年的升: IPCC Sixth Assessment Report: best estimates (very likely range) of warming in 2081–2100 relative to 1850–1900 are about 1.4°C (1.0–1.8) for SSP1-1.9, about 1.8°C (1.3–2.4) for SSP1-2.6, about 2.7°C (2.1–3.5) for SSP2-4.5, about 3.6°C (2.8–4.6) for SSP3-7.0 and about 4.4°C (3.3–5.7) for SSP5-8.5. In the near term (2021–2040), even very low emissions (SSP1-1.9) give over an even chance of reaching 1.5°C, and intermediate to high emissions likely or very likely exceed it.
IPCC 第六次评估报告：相对 1995—2014 年，全球平均海平面到 205: IPCC Sixth Assessment Report: relative to 1995–2014, global mean sea level is likely to rise 0.15–0.30 m by 2050. By 2100 the likely rise is 0.32–0.62 m for SSP1-2.6, 0.44–0.76 m for SSP2-4.5 and 0.63–1.01 m for SSP5-8.5. Ice sheet processes are uncertain, and nearly 2 m under high emissions can't be ruled out. By 2100, extreme sea levels once seen every hundred years may occur every year at over half of tide gauges.
沿海暴露：Kulp 与 Strauss（2019）基于新高程数据估计，目前约 1: Coastal exposure: Kulp and Strauss (2019), using new elevation data, estimate about 110 million people now live on land below the current high tide line. Under low emissions about 190 million live below projected high tide by 2100. Under high emissions up to about 340 million by mid-century and up to about 630 million by 2100 live below annual flood levels. The World Bank's Groundswell report estimates up to about 216 million internal climate migrants across six regions by 2050 without action.
高温对健康与劳动的影响：《柳叶刀倒计时》2025 年报告估计 2012—2021: Heat's effect on health and work: the Lancet Countdown 2025 report estimates about 546,000 heat-related deaths a year worldwide in 2012–2021, about 63% more than in the 1990s. A 2024 ILO report estimates about 2.4 billion workers (about 71%) are exposed to excessive heat at work, linked to about 22.85 million injuries and about 19,000 deaths a year, with exposure highest in Africa and Arab states.
极端事件与生态：IPCC 评估认为过去五十年一遇的极端高温在升温 1.5°C 时: Extremes and ecology: the IPCC assesses that heat extremes once seen every fifty years become about 8.6 times as frequent as pre-industrial at 1.5°C, about 13.9 times at 2°C and about 39.2 times at 4°C. The Global Tipping Points Report 2025 finds warm-water coral reefs have passed their thermal tipping point (central estimate about 1.2°C). An IPCC special report estimates coral reefs decline 70–90% at 1.5°C and over 99% at 2°C. Jägermeyr et al. (2021) estimate global maize yields may fall about 24% by the end of the century under high emissions, with effects appearing around 2030.
国际能源署《世界能源展望 2025》：在恢复使用的现行政策情景中，石油和天然气需: IEA World Energy Outlook 2025: in the revived Current Policies Scenario, oil and gas demand keep growing to mid-century, with oil at about 113 million barrels a day in 2050, and coal begins falling before 2030. In the Stated Policies Scenario oil demand levels off around 2030. About 730 million people still have no electricity and nearly 2 billion rely on polluting cooking. Under Stated Policies peak power demand grows about 40% by 2035, mainly from cooling. Data centres and AI make up under 10% of global power demand growth.
电力转型：Ember《全球电力评论 2026》显示，2025 年可再生能源发电占: The power transition: Ember's Global Electricity Review 2026 shows renewables made 33.8% of global power in 2025, passing coal (33.0%) for the first time. Solar reached about 2,778 TWh, up about 30%, solar and wind met almost all new demand, and fossil generation failed to grow for the first time since 2020. Fossil generation fell in both China and India, and wind and solar made up about 22% in China.
国际能源署：2025 年全球电动汽车销量超过 2000 万辆，约占全球新车销量: IEA: global electric car sales passed 20 million in 2025, about 25% of new cars worldwide and nearly 55% in China. It expects about 23 million in 2026, about 28%, partly from consumer and policy responses to the energy crisis. Renewables 2025 expects about 4,600 GW of new renewable capacity from 2025 to 2030 (about twice 2019–2024), about 80% of it solar, but still short of COP28's goal of tripling capacity by 2030.
2026 年能源冲击：2026 年 2 月底中东爆发涉及伊朗的军事冲突，霍尔木兹: The 2026 energy shock: a military conflict involving Iran broke out in the Middle East at the end of February 2026, and shipping through the Strait of Hormuz was badly disrupted from 4 March. It was declared open for a time during the April ceasefire, but exports through the strait were still disrupted in August. Brent passed US$110 a barrel at one point. The IEA called it the largest supply disruption in the oil market's history, and its August report expects 2026 global oil demand to fall about 1.56 million barrels a day to about 103.3 million, and supply to fall about 4.3 million barrels a day.
气候政策现状：欧盟 2026 年 3 月正式通过 2040 年温室气体净排放较: Climate policy now: in March 2026 the EU formally adopted a legal 2040 target of cutting net greenhouse gases 90% from 1990 (with up to 5 points from international credits from 2036), and delayed its second carbon market (ETS2), covering buildings and road fuel, to 2028. China's 2035 pledge is to cut economy-wide net greenhouse gases 7–10% from peak, with non-fossil energy at 30% of consumption, and its national carbon market plans absolute caps on some sectors from 2027. The US has left the Paris Agreement, and in January 2026 announced it would leave the UN climate convention. COP30 called for at least tripling adaptation finance by 2035.
据斯坦福《AI 指数报告 2026》，2025 年全球企业 AI 投资约 581: According to Stanford's AI Index Report 2026, global corporate AI investment was about US$581.7 billion in 2025, up about 130% on 2024. Private investment was about US$344.7 billion (up 127.5%), with generative AI firms getting about US$170.9 billion. It is highly concentrated: US private AI investment of about US$285.9 billion is 23 times China's (about US$12.4 billion), though this measure understates Chinese government guidance funds (estimated at about US$184 billion from 2000 to 2023).
AI 采用速度快于以往的通用技术：2025 年 88% 的受访组织使用 AI，7: AI is being adopted faster than earlier general-purpose technologies. In 2025, 88% of surveyed organisations used AI and 70% used generative AI in at least one function, but AI agent deployment stayed in single digits in almost all functions. Generative AI reached about 53% population-level adoption within three years, faster than PCs and the internet, with wide national differences (such as about 64% in the UAE and about 61% in Singapore). US consumer surplus from generative AI is estimated at about US$172 billion a year in early 2026.
AI 对就业的影响已在局部显现但尚未体现在总体就业数据中：美国 22-25 岁软: AI's effect on jobs is showing locally but not yet in overall employment data. Employment of US software developers aged 22–25 is down nearly 20% from 2024, and about a third of surveyed organisations expect AI-related staff cuts within a year. In structured tasks such as customer service, software development and marketing, studies report productivity gains of about 14–15%, 26% and 50%, while macro evidence remains limited and inconsistent.
AI 暴露度估计：IMF（2024）认为全球约 40% 的就业暴露于 AI，发达: AI exposure estimates: the IMF (2024) finds about 40% of global jobs exposed to AI, about 60% in advanced economies. The ILO (2025) estimates about a quarter of jobs worldwide have generative AI exposure, only 3.3% at the highest level, with high-income countries (34%) about three times low-income ones (11%). Exposure isn't job loss, and shows more as changes in what the work involves.
自动化潜力估计：麦肯锡全球研究院（2025）认为现有技术在理论上可自动化约 57: Automation potential estimates: the McKinsey Global Institute (2025) finds current technology could in theory automate about 57% of US work hours (software agents about 44%, robots about 13%), a technical potential rather than a job loss forecast. McKinsey (2023) estimates half of today's work activities could be automated between 2030 and 2060, with a midpoint around 2045. The World Economic Forum (2025) expects about 170 million jobs added and about 92 million lost from 2025 to 2030, with about 39% of workers' core skills changing.
专家预测：2023 年对 2778 名 AI 研究者的调查（Grace 等, 2: Expert forecasts: a 2023 survey of 2,778 AI researchers (Grace et al., 2024) put a 10% chance on "unaided machines outperforming humans in every task" by 2027 and 50% by 2047 (13 years earlier than the 2022 survey). The 50% date for "full automation of all occupations" is 2116.
能力增长趋势：Epoch AI 估计前沿 AI 模型训练算力每年增长约 4-5: Capability trends: Epoch AI estimates compute for training frontier AI models grows about 4–5 times a year. The International AI Safety Report 2026 notes the length of tasks AI agents can complete unsupervised doubles about every 7 months, while safety measures lag behind capability.
The IEA estimates global data centres used about 415 TWh in 2024 (about 1.5% of world power), with the US at 45%, China 25% and Europe 15%. In its base case this rises to about 945 TWh in 2030 and about 1,200 TWh in 2035, with AI the main driver.
工业机器人：2024 年全球新装工业机器人约 54.2 万台（与上年基本持平），: Industrial robots: about 542,000 were newly installed worldwide in 2024 (about flat on the year before), with an operational stock of about 4.664 million (4.282 million in 2023) and China taking 54% of new installations. Manufacturing robot density (per 10,000 employees): global average 132, South Korea 1,220, Singapore 818, Germany 449, Japan 446, US 307, China 166 (on updated labour data for China).
人形机器人仍处于起步阶段：Omdia 估计 2025 年全球出货约 1.3 万台: Humanoid robots are still at an early stage. Omdia estimates about 13,000 shipped worldwide in 2025, led by Chinese firms. Unitree says it delivered over 5,500 to end customers in 2025 (above Omdia's earlier estimate of about 4,200). Morgan Stanley forecasts faster spread in the late 2030s, with about a billion in use by 2050.
无人驾驶出租车已进入规模化运营初期：Waymo 2026 年上半年在美国 10: Driverless taxis have entered the early stage of operating at scale. In the first half of 2026 Waymo ran about 500,000 paid trips a week in 10 US cities, with a fleet of about 3,000–3,500 and over 20 million trips in total. Baidu's Apollo Go peaked at over 300,000 weekly orders in the fourth quarter of 2025, with over 20 million trips worldwide by February 2026, covering 26 cities.
电动车：IEA《全球电动汽车展望 2026》显示 2025 年全球电动车销量增长: Electric cars: the IEA's Global EV Outlook 2026 shows global sales up about 20% in 2025 to over 20 million, about a quarter of new cars, nearly 55% in China and about 28% in Europe. Of over 100 countries where EV sales grew, about a third have reached a share of 10% or more. The IEA expects about 23 million sales in 2026, about 28%.
计算与神经技术：谷歌 2024 年 Willow 芯片（105 个量子比特）首次: Computing and neurotechnology: Google's 2024 Willow chip (105 qubits) first showed "below threshold" quantum error correction, and IBM plans a fault-tolerant quantum computer with about 200 logical qubits by 2029. China's National Medical Products Administration approved the first implantable brain-computer interface product on 13 March 2026, and Neuralink had 21 participants by January 2026.
国际电联估计 2025 年全球约 60 亿人上网（约占世界人口四分之三），仍有约: The ITU estimates about 6 billion people were online worldwide in 2025 (about three quarters of world population), with about 2.2 billion still offline, the vast majority in low- and middle-income countries. In about 60% of low- and middle-income countries, internet access is still unaffordable.
抗微生物药物耐药（AMR）：GBD 研究（《柳叶刀》2024）估计 2021 年: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR): the GBD study (The Lancet, 2024) estimates bacterial resistance directly caused about 1.14 million deaths in 2021, with about 4.71 million associated. In the reference scenario direct deaths reach about 1.91 million and associated deaths about 8.22 million in 2050, with about 39 million direct deaths from 2025 to 2050. The World Bank (2017) estimates a high-resistance scenario may cut global GDP by 1.1–3.8% by 2050.
GLP-1 类药物迅速普及：KFF 2025 年 11 月调查显示约 12% 的: GLP-1 drugs spread rapidly. A KFF survey in November 2025 shows about 12% of US adults using them and 18% having used them. The WHO issued its first global guideline on GLP-1 treatment for obesity in December 2025 (a conditional recommendation). The US FDA approved the oral small-molecule GLP-1 orforglipron on 1 April 2026. Semaglutide patents expire from 2026 in India, China, Canada, Brazil and elsewhere, and after Indian generics launched the monthly cost fell to about ₹1,300–4,200.
新型疗法进入临床：默沙东与 Moderna 于 2026 年 8 月宣布个体化: New therapies are entering the clinic. In August 2026 Merck and Moderna announced that a Phase III trial of a personalised mRNA cancer vaccine with immunotherapy (1,137 high-risk melanoma patients after surgery) met its primary endpoint of recurrence-free survival, the first positive Phase III result for an mRNA cancer therapy. The CRISPR gene-editing therapy Casgevy has been approved for sickle cell disease and beta thalassaemia since 2023, extended to ages 2 and up in the US in July 2026. In 2025 the first in vivo base-editing treatment custom-made for a single child was published.
神经退行性疾病：WHO 估计 2021 年全球约 5700 万人患痴呆症，每年新: Neurodegenerative disease: the WHO estimates about 57 million people had dementia worldwide in 2021, with nearly 10 million new cases a year, the seventh leading cause of death. A 2021 WHO report projects about 78 million in 2030 and 139 million in 2050. The US FDA has approved lecanemab (full approval in 2023) and donanemab (2024), and in 2025 the first blood test to aid diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease.
传染病负担：WHO《世界疟疾报告 2025》估计 2024 年约 2.82 亿疟: Infectious disease burden: the WHO's World Malaria Report 2025 estimates about 282 million cases and 610,000 deaths in 2024, with the African region at 94% of cases and 95% of deaths, and antimalarial resistance confirmed or suspected in at least 8 African countries. By July 2025 the WHO had certified 47 countries and 1 territory malaria-free. About 10.7 million people had tuberculosis in 2024, and 1.23 million died.
HIV 预防：WHO 于 2025 年将每年注射两次的长效药物来那帕韦纳入 HI: HIV prevention: in 2025 the WHO added the twice-yearly long-acting injection lenacapavir to its guidelines for pre-exposure prevention. The maker and the Global Fund reached a deal to supply about 2 million people in low- and lower-middle-income countries over three years, and the first doses reached Eswatini and Zambia in November 2025.
精神健康与社会联系：WHO 2025 年报告估计全球超过 10 亿人患有精神健康: Mental health and social connection: a 2025 WHO report estimates over a billion people have mental health conditions (about 14% of the 2021 population), about 727,000 died by suicide in 2021, depression and anxiety cost about US$1 trillion a year, and median government mental health spending is about 2% of health budgets. The WHO Commission on Social Connection estimates about one in six people feel lonely, with loneliness linked to over 871,000 deaths a year.
大流行防范：WHO 成员国于 2025 年通过《大流行协定》，但其开放签署取决于: Pandemic preparedness: WHO members adopted the Pandemic Agreement in 2025, but its opening for signature depends on a Pathogen Access and Benefit Sharing (PABS) annex. On 1 May 2026 the intergovernmental working group agreed to extend the PABS talks (subject to World Health Assembly approval), with results to go to the 80th Assembly in May 2027 or a special session in 2026. H5N1 bird flu keeps spreading among animals and causing sporadic human cases, and the WHO assesses no sustained human-to-human spread so far and low public risk. The WHO counts 1,003 human cases worldwide from January 2003 to 6 September 2026, with 479 deaths.
大流行频率参考：Marani 等（2021）基于 1600 年以来的疫情数据估计: Pandemic frequency for reference: Marani et al. (2021), using outbreak data since 1600, estimate an epidemic of COVID's intensity recurs about every 59 years on average (uncorrected), with about a 38% chance in a lifetime, which may double if new diseases emerge faster. The WHO estimates about 14.9 million excess deaths linked to COVID in 2020–2021. The WHO declared 8 "public health emergencies of international concern" from 2009 to 2024.
乌普萨拉冲突数据项目（UCDP）：2025 年有组织暴力致死约 24.46 万人: Uppsala Conflict Data Program (UCDP): organised violence killed about 244,600 in 2025 (about 187,000 in 2024), the second highest since 1994 (after 2022). State-based armed conflicts reached 65, a record since 1946, across 35 countries. Interstate conflicts doubled for the second year running (8). One-sided violence against civilians killed about 76,500, the highest since 1994, mainly in Sudan.
军费与军控：SIPRI 估计 2025 年全球军费约 2.89 万亿美元，实际增: Military spending and arms control: SIPRI estimates global military spending of about US$2.89 trillion in 2025, up 2.9% in real terms, the 11th straight rise, at about 2.5% of world GDP (the highest since 2009), with Europe up 14% to about US$864 billion. NATO's 2025 Hague summit pledged 5% of GDP for defence and related security by 2035 (3.5% core defence). SIPRI estimates about 12,187 nuclear warheads worldwide in January 2026, about 9,745 in military stockpiles (about 130 more than a year earlier). The US-Russia New START treaty expired on 5 February 2026, leaving the two with no binding limit on strategic nuclear forces for the first time in over fifty years.
截至 2026 年 10 月仍在进行的主要冲突：俄乌战争（2022 年 2 月起: Major conflicts still under way as of October 2026: the Russia-Ukraine war (since February 2022) goes on, with US-brokered talks planned to resume in November 2026 at the earliest and no full ceasefire yet. On 28 February 2026 the US and Israel struck Iran, and Iran then struck targets in several Gulf states and Israel and in effect closed the Strait of Hormuz. A two-week ceasefire began on 7 April and a provisional memorandum was reached through Pakistan on 14 June, but the core disputes over the nuclear program, shipping and sanctions remain and attacks on ships continue. Gaza's October 2025 ceasefire holds in name, but strikes keep coming. Sudan's civil war (since April 2023), Myanmar's civil war (since 2021), the conflict in eastern DR Congo and armed conflict in the Sahel go on. The US also took military action against Venezuela in January 2026.
能源咽喉：霍尔木兹海峡承载约五分之一的全球石油消费量。2026 年海峡实际关闭后: Energy chokepoints: the Strait of Hormuz carries about a fifth of global oil consumption. After it was in effect closed in 2026, Brent passed US$100 a barrel for the first time since August 2022, and IEA members coordinated a release of 400 million barrels of strategic reserves, the largest ever.
冲突与碎片化的经济代价：世界银行等机构评估截至 2024 年底乌克兰未来十年重建: The economic cost of conflict and fragmentation: the World Bank and others assess Ukraine's reconstruction and recovery needs over the next decade at about US$524 billion as of the end of 2024. The UN, EU and World Bank assessed Gaza's needs at about US$53 billion in 2025. The IMF (2023) estimates long-run output losses from trade fragmentation at 0.2% to 7% of world GDP.
航天活动创纪录：2025 年全球进行约 324 次轨道发射尝试，其中 Space: Record space activity: about 324 orbital launch attempts were made worldwide in 2025, about 165 by SpaceX, and Starlink satellites in orbit passed 10,000 in 2026.
重返月球：阿尔忒弥斯 2 号于 2026 年 4 月 1 日发射、4 月 10: Returning to the Moon: Artemis II launched on 1 April 2026 and splashed down on 10 April (US local time), the first crewed lunar flyby in over 50 years. In 2026 NASA changed Artemis III to a docking test in low Earth orbit (with a target of late 2027 set in May), planning a landing with Artemis IV in 2028. China plans a crewed landing before 2030. It completed a low-altitude Long March 10 flight and Mengzhou abort test in February 2026, plans the basic form of its international lunar research station by 2035, and plans to launch Tianwen-3 in 2028 and return Mars samples in 2031. India plans its first space station module in 2028, a station by 2035 and a crewed landing by 2040.
日常生活数字化：世界银行《全球普惠金融指数 2025》显示 2024 年全球 7: Daily life goes digital: the World Bank's Global Findex 2025 shows 79% of adults worldwide had financial accounts in 2024. About a quarter of paid work days among Americans aged 20–64 were worked from home in 2025. A 2025 Common Sense Media survey shows nearly three quarters of US teens have used AI companion apps, about half regularly. From 10 December 2025 Australia bars under-16s from holding major social media accounts.
本世纪末（约 2081—2100 年）相对工业化前的全球升温路径。游戏时间截至: Global warming pathways relative to pre-industrial by the end of this century (about 2081–2100). The game ends in 2090, when warming is a little below each pathway's 2100 value. All three pathways see 1.5°C crossed around 2030.

Warming still briefly passes 1.5°C but levels off after mid-century, and extreme heat and sea level rise continue on a smaller scale.
联合国环境署《排放差距报告 2025》：条件性国家自主贡献加全部净零承诺对应约: UNEP Emissions Gap Report 2025: conditional national pledges plus all net-zero pledges correspond to about 1.9°C. The IPCC AR6 best estimate for SSP1-2.6 in 2081–2100 is 1.8°C. This pathway needs pledges to be met broadly, which looks unlikely on current policy progress.
据推演，各国大体延续现行政策并部分兑现承诺，可再生能源继续扩张但化石燃料退出缓慢: In this projection countries broadly keep current policies and partly meet their pledges. Renewables keep growing but fossil fuels exit slowly, and warming reaches about 2.5–2.9°C by the end of the century, close to IPCC SSP2-4.5, the IEA's Stated Policies Scenario (about 2.5°C) and UNEP's current policy estimate (about 2.8°C). 2°C may be crossed from the late 2040s to the 2050s, heatwaves, heavy rain and coastal floods clearly increase, and tropical and arid regions are hit hardest.
联合国环境署 2025 年估计现行政策下升温约 2.8°C；国际能源署《世界能源: UNEP's 2025 estimate under current policies is about 2.8°C, the IEA's World Energy Outlook 2025 Stated Policies Scenario about 2.5°C, and IPCC AR6 SSP2-4.5 2.7°C (2.1–3.5). IPCC Working Group II assesses that tropical, low-income and farming-reliant regions suffer the greatest losses.
据推演，地缘分裂与能源安全优先导致化石燃料长期维持高位，减排承诺大面积落空，本世: In this projection geopolitical division and energy security priorities keep fossil fuels high for a long time, emissions pledges widely fail, and warming reaches about 3.2–4°C by the end of the century, close to IPCC SSP3-7.0 (about 3.6°C) or the high end of the IEA's Current Policies Scenario (near 3°C). 2°C may be crossed in the 2040s, South Asia, the Persian Gulf, the Sahel and elsewhere see frequent extreme humid heat, sea level rise speeds up, and food output and outdoor work are clearly affected.
IPCC AR6 SSP3-7.0 的 2081—2100 年最佳估计为 3.6: The IPCC AR6 best estimate for SSP3-7.0 in 2081–2100 is 3.6°C (2.8–4.6). The IEA's 2025 Current Policies Scenario nears 3°C. Kulp and Strauss (2019) show people exposed to coastal floods rise greatly under high emissions, and Jägermeyr et al. (2021) show maize yields may fall about 24% by the end of the century under high emissions.
2026—2090 年全球增长与分配的主线。三种情景都以世界银行、OECD 对长: The main line of global growth and distribution from 2026 to 2090. All three scenarios start from the World Bank and OECD view that long-run growth is slowing, and differ on how fast emerging economies catch up, whether trade and finance split, and whether high debt can be defused smoothly.

据推演，贸易与技术扩散大体保持开放，印度、东南亚和部分非洲国家实现较快追赶，非洲: In this projection trade and technology spread stay broadly open. India, Southeast Asia and some African countries catch up fairly fast, and Africa's demographic dividend is partly realised. Advanced economies grow slowly but steadily, global poverty keeps falling, and income gaps between countries narrow.
高盛《通往 2075 之路》认为新兴市场追赶仍将持续，人口大国经济规模上升；世界: Goldman Sachs's "The Path to 2075" holds that emerging markets keep catching up and populous countries' economies grow. The World Bank notes that policies raising productivity, labour supply and investment can reverse falling potential growth.
据推演，贸易与技术壁垒长期存在，供应链按地缘阵营重组，全球增长维持在约 2.5%: In this projection trade and technology barriers last, supply chains reorganise around geopolitical blocs, and global growth stays low at about 2.5–3% and gradually slips. Advanced economies are dragged down by ageing and high debt, many low-income countries stop catching up, and extreme poverty concentrates in sub-Saharan Africa and fragile states.
世界银行估计 2022—2030 年全球潜在增长率仅约 2.2%，为三十年来最低: The World Bank estimates global potential growth at only about 2.2% for 2022–2030, the lowest in thirty years. An IMF staff discussion note (2023) estimates long-run trade fragmentation may cost about 0.2–7% of world output. The IMF's October 2026 forecast puts global growth at 3.1% in 2026.
据推演，高利率与高债务叠加，在 2030—2040 年代引发一连串主权债务和银行: In this projection high interest rates and high debt combine to set off a string of sovereign debt and banking crises in the 2030s and 2040s. Some frontier markets default, a few advanced economies see bond market turmoil and are forced to cut spending. Unemployment rises, pensions and public services shrink, inequality deepens and migration pressure grows.
IMF 预计全球公共债务到 2029 年接近 GDP 的 100%；美国 CBO: The IMF expects global public debt near 100% of GDP by 2029, and the US CBO expects federal debt at about 175% of GDP in 2056. Laeven and Valencia (2018) count 151 systemic banking crises and 74 sovereign debt crises worldwide from 1970 to 2017, finding sovereign debt and currency crises often coincide with or follow banking crises.
低生育率社会如何应对人口减少与老龄化：鼓励生育、接受持续低生育、或以移民补充劳动: How low-fertility societies respond to population decline and ageing: encouraging births, accepting lasting low fertility, or adding labour through migration. High-fertility regions (sub-Saharan Africa, parts of South and West Asia) gradually decline along the UN WPP medium variant in every branch.
region_overrides 中的同名键替换该分支的全局值；migratio: Keys of the same name in region_overrides replace the branch's global values. migration_push_add represents emigration opportunity and pressure in source regions.
据推演，东亚和欧洲多国在住房、托育、育儿补贴和工作时间方面持续投入，结婚和生育出: In this projection many countries in East Asia and Europe keep investing in housing, childcare, child subsidies and working hours, and marriages and births pick up somewhat (South Korea's rebound from 0.72 in 2023 to about 0.80 in 2025 carries on, for example), though still below replacement. Population decline slows, and labour shortages ease slightly.
韩国 2025 年出生人数增长 6.7%、总和生育率约 0.80；中国 2025: South Korea's births rose 6.7% in 2025 with a total fertility rate of about 0.80, and China began a child subsidy for under-3s in 2025 (3,600 yuan per child a year). But international experience shows pro-birth policies usually bring only limited rebounds, so this gets a lower probability.
据推演，低生育率在东亚、南欧、东欧和拉美长期维持，人口按 UN WPP 中方案或: In this projection low fertility lasts in East Asia, southern and eastern Europe and Latin America, and populations shrink along the UN WPP medium variant or faster. A shrinking workforce drags on growth, pension and health burdens grow, and people leave small towns and the countryside faster.
UN WPP 2024 中方案中东亚总和生育率 2050 年仍仅约 1.2；日本: In the UN WPP 2024 medium variant East Asia's total fertility rate is still only about 1.2 in 2050. Japan's 2025 rate was 1.14 with births at a record low, officially about 15 years ahead of projections. China had about 7.92 million births in 2025.
据推演，多数高收入老龄化国家（北美、西欧、大洋洲以及部分东亚国家）大幅扩大劳动移: In this projection most ageing high-income countries (North America, Western Europe, Oceania and some of East Asia) greatly expand labour migration and settlement routes, using migrants to staff care, construction, manufacturing and other sectors. Source countries get more remittances but also lose talent, and integration becomes a long-term social issue.
全球国际移民 2024 年达约 3.04 亿；UN WPP 2024 显示美国人: International migrants reached about 304 million in 2024. UN WPP 2024 shows US population growth comes mainly from migration. Japan's IPSS 2023 projection raised net foreign inflow to about 164,000 a year by 2040. The World Bank estimates sub-Saharan Africa will supply over three quarters of the global rise in working-age people by 2050.
全球能源体系的转型速度。2025 年可再生能源发电已首次超过煤电，2026 年中: The speed of the global energy transition. Renewables first passed coal in power generation in 2025, and the 2026 energy shock from the Middle East conflict also raised the priority of energy security and electrification.
region_overrides 中的同名键替换该分支的全局值。化石燃料出口国在: Keys of the same name in region_overrides replace the branch's global values. Fossil fuel exporters face falling income under a fast transition, and benefit in the short term under fossil lock-in.
据推演，太阳能、风能、储能和电动汽车成本继续下降，能源安全考量加速电气化；全球电: In this projection solar, wind, storage and electric car costs keep falling, and energy security concerns speed up electrification. Electric cars pass half of global sales by the early 2030s, oil demand peaks in the late 2020s and then falls, and coal power exits quickly in the 2030s. Cleaner air brings health gains, but oil and gas exporters' budgets are squeezed and they must diversify faster.
Ember：2025 年可再生能源发电占比 33.8% 超过煤电；国际能源署：2: Ember: renewables at 33.8% of power in 2025, passing coal. IEA: electric cars at about 25% of new car sales in 2025 and near 30% in 2026. The WHO estimates outdoor and household air pollution together cause about 6.7 million premature deaths a year, and burning less fossil fuel brings health gains.
据推演，可再生能源继续快速增长并满足大部分新增电力需求，但石油和天然气需求在 2: In this projection renewables keep growing fast and meet most new power demand, but oil and gas demand stay on a high plateau through the 2030s and 2040s, and coal's exit varies by country. The transition is faster in China and Europe, and slower in some emerging economies and resource exporters.
国际能源署《世界能源展望 2025》既定政策情景：石油需求约在 2030 年前后: The IEA's World Energy Outlook 2025 Stated Policies Scenario: oil demand levels off around 2030 and gas demand grows into the 2030s. Renewables 2025 expects new capacity from 2025 to 2030 at about twice the past five years, but below the tripling goal.
据推演，能源安全担忧、地缘竞争与电网建设滞后使各国延长煤电和油气设施寿命，石油和: In this projection energy security fears, geopolitical rivalry and slow grid building lead countries to extend the life of coal and oil and gas plants, and oil and gas demand grow to mid-century. Energy prices swing often, air pollution and climate risk stay high, and oil and gas exporters get higher income in the medium term.
The IEA's World Energy Outlook 2025 Current Policies Scenario: oil demand at about 113 million barrels a day in 2050, gas demand growing to mid-century, and warming near 3°C by 2100. The 2026 supply disruption at the Strait of Hormuz shows the risk of price shocks from reliance on oil and gas.
老龄化社会如何调整养老金与退休制度。各国已立法的退休年龄时间表（如中国 2025: How ageing societies adjust pensions and retirement. Each country's legislated retirement age schedule (such as China's gradual rise from 2025 to 2040 and Denmark's 70 in 2040) comes separately from national system data, and retirement_age_add in this dimension means extra years added by 2060 beyond what is legislated.
region_overrides 中的同名键替换该分支的全局值；正规养老金覆盖率: Keys of the same name in region_overrides replace the branch's global values. In regions with low formal pension coverage (sub-Saharan Africa, South Asia) retirement age changes affect few people.
据推演，各国较早启动参数改革：退休年龄与预期寿命挂钩、缴费率小幅上调、加强个人养: In this projection countries begin parametric reforms early, linking retirement age to life expectancy, slightly raising contributions, and strengthening personal pension saving and support for older workers. Pension systems stay sustainable, and tension between generations stays manageable.
OECD《养老金概览 2023》显示多国已将退休年龄与预期寿命挂钩；韩国 202: The OECD's Pensions at a Glance 2023 shows many countries have linked retirement age to life expectancy. South Korea's 2025 reform raises contributions from 9% to 13% in stages, and Singapore, Denmark and others have legislated phased rises in retirement age.
据推演，改革往往在基金接近耗尽时才临时通过，靠财政转移和小幅延迟退休应对；退休年: In this projection reforms often pass only as funds near depletion, relying on budget transfers and small retirement delays. Retirement ages creep up, benefits grow slowly in real terms, and public confidence in pensions stays low.
美国社会保障 OASI 信托基金预计 2032 年底耗尽；法国 2023 年退休: The US Social Security OASI trust fund is expected to run out at the end of 2032. France's 2023 retirement reform was suspended until 2028 in 2025–2026, showing how reform can reverse politically. A 2025 South Korean poll showed over half of respondents don't trust the National Pension.

2026-2090 年 AI 能力与扩散速度的三种推演路径。概率为游戏设定的主观: Three projected paths for AI capability and spread from 2026 to 2090. The probabilities are subjective weights set for the game, drawing on expert surveys, compute trends and macroeconomic research.
推演：AI 像电力和互联网一样在 10-30 年间逐步渗透各行各业。办公、教育、: Projection: AI gradually spreads through every industry over 10 to 30 years, like electricity and the internet. AI assistants become common in offices, education and health care, some occupations are restructured, but most people adapt by changing jobs and retraining. Productivity growth rises modestly, and gains go mostly to capital and the highly skilled. Basis: Goldman Sachs (2023) estimates generative AI could raise global GDP by about 7% within ten years. McKinsey (2023) puts the midpoint for automating half of work activities around 2045. Acemoglu (2024) sees limited gains to total factor productivity within ten years.
推演：AI 能力按近年趋势持续高速增长，2030 年代中期在几乎所有认知任务上达: Projection: AI capability keeps growing fast on recent trends, reaching expert level on almost all cognitive tasks by the mid-2030s, and robots enter physical work on a large scale in the 2040s. Economic growth clearly speeds up, but unemployment and inequality rise during the transition, and countries are forced to rebuild tax, social security and education systems. Basis: Epoch AI estimates frontier training compute grows 4–5 times a year. Agent task length doubles about every 7 months. Expert surveys put high-level machine intelligence at 10% by 2027 and 50% by 2047. McKinsey (2025) estimates current technology could in theory automate about 57% of US work hours.
推演：大模型能力提升在 2020 年代末放缓，算力、电力与数据成本难以被收入覆盖: Projection: large model progress slows in the late 2020s, compute, power and data costs can't be covered by revenue, and AI investment corrects. Accidents and disputes over copyright and jobs push countries to adopt strict licensing and audits. AI becomes a useful but not disruptive tool, with small effects on growth and jobs. Basis: the AI Index 2026 says macro productivity evidence is still "early and inconsistent" and investment highly concentrated. The IEA expects data centre power use to more than double by 2030, so power may become a constraint. The EU AI Act is already law.
长寿医学、传染病控制与抗微生物药物耐药的三种推演路径。寿命修正为相对于 UN W: Three projected paths for longevity medicine, infectious disease control and antimicrobial resistance. Lifespan adjustments are added to the UN WPP baseline trend.
推演：个体化 mRNA 肿瘤疫苗、基因编辑、阿尔茨海默病早筛与预防治疗、衰老干预: Projection: personalised mRNA cancer vaccines, gene editing, early screening and preventive treatment for Alzheimer's, and anti-ageing drugs mature in turn and fall in price. New tools bring malaria and other infectious diseases near elimination. Healthy lifespan clearly lengthens in high-income countries, and retirement ages rise with it. Low- and middle-income countries benefit greatly from cheap drugs and vaccines, though gaps in access remain. Basis: a positive Phase III result for an mRNA cancer vaccine in 2026, cheap generics after GLP-1 patents expire, and a Lancet commission's view that malaria can be eliminated by 2050.
推演：新药与新疗法持续出现，但价格高、普及慢，主要惠及高收入国家；传染病负担缓慢: Projection: new drugs and therapies keep coming, but are costly and slow to spread, mainly helping high-income countries. The burden of infectious disease falls slowly, and resistance is broadly held in check but not reversed. Lifespan follows the slow rise of the UN WPP medium variant, revised up slightly. Basis: the WHO's 2030 malaria and tuberculosis goals are off track, and new therapies (such as Casgevy and anti-amyloid drugs) are approved but reach few people.
推演：卫生援助削减、新抗生素研发停滞和抗生素滥用叠加，耐药感染使手术、化疗和分娩: Projection: cuts to health aid, stalled antibiotic research and antibiotic misuse combine, and resistant infections raise the risks of surgery, chemotherapy and childbirth. New infectious diseases come more often, lifespan gains fall short of the baseline, and South Asia and sub-Saharan Africa are hit hardest. Basis: in the GBD reference scenario resistance directly kills about 1.91 million in 2050 and about 39 million from 2025 to 2050. The World Bank estimates a high-resistance scenario may cut global GDP by 3.8% by 2050.
以阵营与地区为单位描述的三种推演路径，不预测尚未处于战争状态的具体国家之间的战争: Three projected paths described by bloc and region. They don't predict wars between specific countries not already at war.
推演：大国竞争持续但保持在可控范围，2020 年代末主要热点冲突（东欧、中东、苏: Projection: great power rivalry continues but stays manageable. In the late 2020s the main hot conflicts (Eastern Europe, the Middle East, Sudan and others) reach ceasefires or settlements through talks one by one. Limited cooperation appears on arms control, public health and AI safety. Trade and technology split in some areas, but the framework of globalisation broadly holds.
推演：世界分化为若干相互竞争的阵营，芯片、AI、数据与能源供应链按阵营重组；军费: Projection: the world divides into competing blocs, and chip, AI, data and energy supply chains reorganise around them. Military spending and nuclear arsenals keep growing with no binding arms control. Some hot conflicts freeze into long standoffs, and risks from proxy conflicts and sea lanes rise. Fragmentation drags on global growth. Basis: UCDP recorded 65 state-based conflicts in 2025 (a record). SIPRI recorded 11 straight years of rising military spending. New START expired in 2026. The IMF estimates long-run losses from trade fragmentation at 0.2–7% of world GDP.
推演：停火安排相继破裂，东欧、中东和非洲等地同时出现高强度战争，海上通道与能源设: Projection: ceasefires collapse in turn, high-intensity wars rage at once in Eastern Europe, the Middle East, Africa and elsewhere, sea lanes and energy sites are repeatedly hit, refugees and displaced people reach new records, and international cooperation is badly weakened. Basis: UCDP recorded interstate conflicts doubling for two years running and organised violence deaths the second highest since 1994 in 2025. The 2026 Middle East conflict in effect closed the Strait of Hormuz and shocked global energy.
载人深空探索与商业航天的三种推演路径，对经济影响很小，主要决定航天里程碑是否及何: Three projected paths for crewed deep space exploration and commercial spaceflight. They have little economic effect, mainly deciding whether and when space milestones happen.
推演：可重复使用重型火箭成熟、发射成本大幅下降，月球南极在 2040 年代前后出: Projection: reusable heavy rockets mature and launch costs fall sharply, a permanently crewed base appears at the Moon's south pole around the 2040s, and humans first land on Mars around 2040. Commercial space stations and space tourism become routine. Basis: a record of about 324 orbital launches worldwide in 2025, and both China and the US plan crewed lunar landings around 2030.
推演：中美在 2030 年前后实现载人登月，月球基地建设缓慢推进，载人火星任务推: Projection: China and the US land people on the Moon around 2030, lunar base building moves slowly, and crewed Mars missions slip to the late 2040s or later. Satellite internet is the space achievement ordinary people notice most.
推演：财政压力、技术挫折或事故导致载人登月之后的深空计划大幅推迟，太空活动以通信: Projection: budget pressure, technical setbacks or accidents greatly delay deep space plans after crewed lunar landings, and space activity centres on communications, navigation and remote sensing satellites. Basis: the Artemis schedule has shifted repeatedly, and Mars crew timelines are seen as lacking a complete plan.
孟加拉国仍满足全部三项毕业标准，但已向联合国发展政策委员会申请延长准备期至 20: Bangladesh still meets all three graduation criteria, but has asked the UN Committee for Development Policy to extend its preparation period to 2029.

国际能源署称 2026 年为石油市场史上最大供应中断，并预计 2026 年电动车: The IEA calls 2026 the largest supply disruption in the oil market's history, and expects electric cars to near 30% of sales in 2026, partly from countries' responses to the energy crisis.

UN WPP 2024 中方案分年龄数据：美国 65 岁以上占比 2024 年约: UN WPP 2024 medium variant by age: the share of Americans over 65 is about 17.9% in 2024 and about 20.4% in 2030.

丹麦议会 2025 年 5 月以 81 票对 21 票通过的法律。: The law passed by Denmark's parliament by 81 votes to 21 in May 2025.

IMF 2026 年 10 月预测印度 2026、2027 年增长均约 7.0%: The IMF's October 2026 forecast puts India's growth at about 7.0% in both 2026 and 2027, and Germany's long-run growth stays below 1.5%.
据韩国媒体 2026 年 6 月和 10 月报道，朝野两党分别在准备延长退休年龄: Korean media reported in June and October 2026 that both main parties are preparing plans to raise the retirement age, the government says it will offer its own, and the labour ministry says a bill should be handled within the year. 国际能源署《可再生能源 2025》主案例；Ember 估计装机缺口约 15%、发: IEA Renewables 2025 main case. Ember estimates a gap of about 15% in capacity and about 28% in generation.

世界银行《贫困、繁荣与地球 2024》及 2025 年贫困线更新。: The World Bank's Poverty, Prosperity, and Planet 2024 and its 2025 poverty line update.
新加坡人力部 2026 年宣布的分阶段上调计划。: The phased rise announced by Singapore's Ministry of Manpower in 2026.
IMF 工作人员讨论文件（2023）估计长期贸易碎片化成本约为全球产出的 0.2: An IMF staff discussion note (2023) estimates long-run trade fragmentation costs at about 0.2–7% of world output.
德国法定养老保险退休年龄过渡安排。: Transitional retirement age arrangements in Germany's statutory pension insurance.

Ember：2025 年煤电占比首次跌破三分之一，中国和印度化石燃料发电均下降；: Ember: coal's share of power fell below a third for the first time in 2025, with fossil generation down in both China and India. In the IEA Current Policies Scenario coal demand also begins falling before 2030.
国际能源署：电动车占新车销量 2025 年约 25%、2026 年接近 30%，: IEA: electric cars at about 25% of new car sales in 2025 and near 30% in 2026, and about 55% in China in 2025.
Laeven 与 Valencia（2018）统计 1970—2017 年共发生: Laeven and Valencia (2018) count 74 sovereign debt crises from 1970 to 2017. The IMF expects global public debt to near 100% of GDP.
韩国总和生育率由 2023 年 0.72 回升至 2024 年 0.75、202: South Korea's total fertility rate recovered from 0.72 in 2023 to 0.75 in 2024 and about 0.80 in 2025. The UN WPP 2024 medium variant assumes about 1.03 in 2050.
美国社会保障 2026 年受托人报告：75 年精算赤字为应税工资的 4.42%；: The 2026 US Social Security Trustees Report: the 75-year actuarial deficit is 4.42% of taxable payroll. In 1983 reform passed just as the fund neared depletion.
美国社会保障署国际动态对韩国 2025 年改革的介绍；韩国法定时间表。: The US Social Security Administration's International Update on South Korea's 2025 reform, and Korea's legal schedule.
UN WPP 2024 显示多个高收入国家劳动年龄人口减少；美国等国人口增长高度: UN WPP 2024 shows working-age populations falling in many high-income countries, and population growth in the US and others relying heavily on migration.
美国社会保障 2026 年受托人报告：OASI 基金预计 2032 年第四季度耗: The 2026 US Social Security Trustees Report: the OASI fund is expected to run out in the fourth quarter of 2032, and could then pay about 78%.
COP30（贝伦）最终决定的适应资金目标；美国已退出《巴黎协定》，资金缺口风险较: The adaptation finance goal in the final decision at COP30 (Belém). With the US out of the Paris Agreement, the risk of a funding gap is high.
IMF 估计该地区每年可能需要新增最多约 1500 万个就业岗位；国际劳工组织显: The IMF estimates the region may need up to about 15 million new jobs a year. The ILO shows about 2.1 billion informal workers worldwide, concentrated in Africa and South Asia.
中国共产党第二十次全国代表大会报告提出的 2035 年总体目标；IMF 预测中国: The overall goals for 2035 from the report to the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China. The IMF forecasts China's growth at about 4.0% in 2027, slowing in the medium term.
气候行动追踪组织估计，按现行政策中国 2035 年排放可能比 2024 年低约: Climate Action Tracker estimates that under current policies China's 2035 emissions may be about 4–24% below 2024 (its credibility analysis gives about 9–16%), while the national pledge is roughly 5–10% below 2024.
中国社会科学院世界社保研究中心《中国养老金精算报告 2019—2050》测算（未: The Chinese Academy of Social Sciences' World Social Security Research Centre, in its China Pension Actuarial Report 2019–2050, calculates (without later reforms such as raising the retirement age) that the urban employee pension's accumulated balance may run out around 2035. UN WPP 2024 shows about 420 million Chinese over 60 in 2035.
国际能源署《世界能源展望 2025》：既定政策情景下到 2035 年峰值电力需求: IEA World Energy Outlook 2025: under Stated Policies peak power demand grows about 40% by 2035, mainly from cooling.
《全球临界点报告 2025》认为暖水珊瑚礁已越过热临界点；IPCC 估计升温 1: The Global Tipping Points Report 2025 finds warm-water coral reefs have passed their thermal tipping point. The IPCC estimates reefs decline 70–90% at 1.5°C. Since 2023 over 80% of the world's coral reef areas have suffered bleaching-level heat stress.
国际能源署：全球约 7.3 亿人无电、近 20 亿人缺乏清洁炊事，主要集中在撒哈: IEA: about 730 million people worldwide have no electricity and nearly 2 billion lack clean cooking, mainly in sub-Saharan Africa.
Ballester 等（2023，《自然·医学》）估计 2022 年夏季欧洲约: Ballester et al. (2023, Nature Medicine) estimate about 61,672 heat-related deaths in Europe in summer 2022. Europe is among the fastest-warming continents.
联合国环境署《排放差距报告 2025》：2035 年年排放需比 2019 年下降: UNEP Emissions Gap Report 2025: annual emissions in 2035 must fall 35% from 2019 (for 2°C) or 55% (for 1.5°C).
全球国际移民 2024 年约 3.04 亿；日本 IPSS 推计上调外国人净迁入: International migrants numbered about 304 million in 2024. Japan's IPSS projection raised its net foreign inflow assumption. The World Bank shows future working-age growth concentrated in sub-Saharan Africa.
Im 等（2017）预计高排放下南亚人口密集的农业区可能出现接近人体生理极限的湿: Im et al. (2017) project that densely populated farming regions of South Asia may see humid heat near human physiological limits under high emissions. 国际能源署：全球约 7.3 亿人无电可用，其提出的新路径可在 2035 年实现普: IEA: about 730 million people worldwide have no electricity, and its proposed new path could bring universal power by 2035 and clean cooking by 2040.

印度尼西亚总统 2025 年宣布的爪哇北岸海堤计划及资金安排。: The North Java sea wall plan and funding announced by Indonesia's president in 2025.

欧盟理事会 2026 年 3 月正式通过的 2040 年气候目标。: The 2040 climate target formally adopted by the Council of the EU in March 2026.

英国环境署《泰晤士河口 2100》规划及其指导文件。: The UK Environment Agency's Thames Estuary 2100 plan and its guidance.
