UN WPP 2024 中方案分年龄数据：中国 80 岁以上占比 2024 年约: UN WPP 2024 medium variant by age: China's share over 80 is about 2.5% in 2024 and about 10.5% in 2050.
Kulp 与 Strauss（2019）：目前约 2.5 亿人居住在低于年度洪水: Kulp and Strauss (2019): about 250 million people now live on land below annual flood levels, and up to about 340 million by mid-century under high emissions. The IPCC expects global sea level up 0.15–0.30 m by 2050 relative to 1995–2014.
联合国经社部 2025 年 11 月发布的《世界城镇化展望 2025》。: UN DESA's World Urbanization Prospects 2025, published in November 2025.
国际山地综合发展中心（ICIMOD）2023 年评估认为，升温 1.5—2°C: A 2023 assessment by the International Centre for Integrated Mountain Development (ICIMOD) finds the region's glaciers may lose 30–50% of their volume by 2100 at 1.5–2°C of warming, with meltwater expected to peak around mid-century.
UN WPP 2024 中方案分年龄数据；国际劳工组织指出南亚非正规就业比例很高: UN WPP 2024 medium variant by age. The ILO notes South Asia's very high share of informal work.
联合国经社部《世界城镇化展望 2018》；2025 年新版采用不同口径，但同样显: UN DESA's World Urbanization Prospects 2018. The new 2025 edition uses a different measure, but also shows South Asia and Africa with the fastest urban growth.
UN WPP 2024 中方案人口序列；这些国家的总和生育率均已接近或低于更替水: UN WPP 2024 medium variant population. Total fertility rates in these countries are all near or below replacement.
欧盟《欧洲气候法》2050 年气候中和目标、中国 2060 年碳中和承诺、印度: The EU's European Climate Law goal of climate neutrality by 2050, China's 2060 carbon neutrality pledge, and India's 2070 net-zero pledge. UNEP estimates warming of about 1.9°C if all pledges are met.
IPCC AR6：SSP2-4.5 与 SSP3-7.0 情景 2041—206: IPCC AR6: best estimates of warming in 2041–2060 under SSP2-4.5 and SSP3-7.0 are about 2.0–2.1°C, and 50-year heat extremes are about 13.9 times as frequent at 2°C.
UN WPP 2024 中方案分年龄人口数据：80 岁以上人口增速远快于总人口。: UN WPP 2024 medium variant by age: people over 80 grow much faster than the total population.
UN WPP 2024：全球总和生育率 2024 年约 2.25，并持续下降；超: UN WPP 2024: the global total fertility rate is about 2.25 in 2024 and keeps falling, and over half of countries and territories are already below 2.1.
UN WPP 2024 中方案：欧洲人口已于 2020 年前后见顶；意大利 20: UN WPP 2024 medium variant: Europe's population peaked around 2020. Italy is at about 51.9 million in 2050 and about 37.7 million in 2090, and Ukraine about 17.9 million in 2090.
UN WPP 2024 中方案：亚洲人口 2054 年约 52.9 亿，拉美与加: UN WPP 2024 medium variant: Asia's population is about 5.29 billion in 2054, and Latin America and the Caribbean's about 731 million in 2053.
联合国人口基金对印度人口红利窗口的估计；UN WPP 2024 显示印度劳动年龄: The UN Population Fund's estimate of India's demographic dividend window. UN WPP 2024 shows India's working-age population peaking around 2050 (about 1.13 billion).
UN WPP 2024 中方案：巴基斯坦 2050 年约 3.72 亿、尼日利亚: UN WPP 2024 medium variant: Pakistan is at about 372 million in 2050, Nigeria about 359 million and the US about 381 million, with the first two continuing to grow fairly fast afterwards.
IPSS 2023 年推计；日本 2025 年日本国籍出生数 671,236 人: IPSS 2023 projection. Japan's births of Japanese nationals were 671,236 in 2025, officially about 15 years ahead of projections.
IPCC AR6 第二工作组小岛屿章节评估：环礁岛屿面临海平面上升带来的宜居性风: IPCC AR6 Working Group II small islands chapter: atoll islands face habitability risks from sea level rise. The IPCC expects sea level may rise 0.44–1.01 m by 2100 under intermediate to high emissions.
IPCC AR6：SSP1-2.6 情景 2081—2100 年升温最佳估计约: IPCC AR6: the best estimate of warming in 2081–2100 under SSP1-2.6 is about 1.8°C, and warming largely stops after net-zero CO2. Sea level rise has long-term inertia.
UN WPP 2024 中方案：印度总和生育率 2024 年约 1.96，已低于: UN WPP 2024 medium variant: India's total fertility rate was about 1.96 in 2024, already below replacement, and population growth continues on the momentum of its age structure.
韩国 2025 年国民年金改革后的财政推算。: Fiscal projections after South Korea's 2025 National Pension reform.
UN WPP 2024 中方案人口序列（2070 年约 9.99 亿、2090: UN WPP 2024 medium variant population (about 999 million in 2070, about 745 million in 2090 and about 633 million in 2100).
高盛 2022 年长期预测；该预测以人口增长与生产率追赶为前提，并提示环境灾难和: Goldman Sachs's 2022 long-term forecast. It assumes population growth and productivity catch-up, and warns of risks such as environmental disaster and populism.
Pal 与 Eltahir（2016，《自然·气候变化》）预计高排放下西南亚部分: Pal and Eltahir (2016, Nature Climate Change) project that wet-bulb temperatures in parts of Southwest Asia may exceed the human adaptability threshold under high emissions.
联合国新闻对 WPP 2024 的概述：65 岁以上人口预计在 2070 年代后: UN News overview of WPP 2024: those over 65 are expected to outnumber under-18s in the late 2070s, and age data put the crossover around 2078.
Hoornweg, D. & Pope, K. (2017) Populatio: Hoornweg, D. & Pope, K. (2017), Population predictions for the world's largest cities in the 21st century, Environment & Urbanization 29(1). UN WPP 2024 shows Nigeria, DR Congo and Tanzania still growing in 2090.
IPCC AR6：SSP3-7.0 情景 2081—2100 年升温最佳估计 3: IPCC AR6: the best estimate of warming in 2081–2100 under SSP3-7.0 is 3.6°C (2.8–4.6). The IEA Current Policies Scenario nears 3°C by 2100.
UN WPP 2024：世界人口本世纪内见顶的概率约 80%，中方案峰值约在 2: UN WPP 2024: about an 80% chance world population peaks this century, with the medium variant peak around the mid-2080s.
IPCC AR6 第一工作组：到 2100 年，在所有考虑的情景下，过去百年一遇: IPCC AR6 Working Group I: by 2100, under all scenarios considered, extreme sea levels once seen every hundred years are expected at least once a year at over half of tide gauges.
AI Index 2026：2025 年 88% 的受访组织使用 AI、70%: AI Index 2026: in 2025, 88% of surveyed organisations used AI and 70% used generative AI in at least one function, but agent deployment stayed in single digits in almost all functions. The International AI Safety Report 2026 notes the length of tasks agents can complete alone doubles about every 7 months. On this basis the projection has agents entering routine office work within 2 to 5 years.
AI Index 2026：美国 22-25 岁软件开发者就业较 2024 年下: AI Index 2026: employment of US software developers aged 22–25 is down nearly 20% from 2024, and about a third of surveyed organisations expect AI-related staff cuts within a year. The ILO (2025) estimates 34% of jobs in high-income countries have generative AI exposure, highest in clerical work.
联合国教科文组织 2023 年发布生成式 AI 教育与研究应用指南，建议设定使用: UNESCO's 2023 guidance on generative AI in education and research recommends age limits and rules for use. AI Index 2026 shows generative AI reaching about 53% population-level adoption within three years, and warns that over-reliance on AI may bring long-term learning losses.
美国 FDA 持续更新已授权的 AI 医疗器械清单（2026 年仍有新批准）；A: The US FDA keeps updating its list of authorised AI medical devices (with new approvals in 2026). AI Index 2026 records measurable productivity gains from AI in structured tasks.
IEA《能源与 AI》基准情景：数据中心用电从 2024 年约 415 太瓦时（: IEA Energy and AI base case: data centre power use grows from about 415 TWh in 2024 (about 1.5%) to about 945 TWh in 2030 and about 1,200 TWh in 2035, with the US at 45% and China at 25% in 2024.
《国际 AI 安全报告 2026》指出领先系统在国际数学奥林匹克题目上达到金牌水: The International AI Safety Report 2026 notes leading systems reached gold medal level on International Mathematical Olympiad problems and over 80% accuracy on some graduate-level science questions. Epoch AI estimates frontier model training compute grows 4–5 times a year.
Grace 等（2024）对 2778 名 AI 研究者的调查：「无辅助机器在所: Grace et al. (2024) survey of 2,778 AI researchers: 10% chance of "unaided machines outperforming humans in every task" by 2027 and 50% by 2047, 13 years earlier than the 2022 survey. The transformative scenario takes the early end of the distribution.
Grace 等（2024）调查的中位预测为 2047 年；IEA 预计数据中心用: The median forecast in Grace et al. (2024) is 2047. The IEA expects data centre power use of about 1,200 TWh by 2035, and energy and infrastructure may slow expansion.
麦肯锡全球研究院（2025）估计现有技术在理论上可自动化约 57% 的美国工作时: The McKinsey Global Institute (2025) estimates current technology could in theory automate about 57% of US work hours, and the IMF (2024) estimates about 60% of jobs in advanced economies are exposed to AI. The transformative scenario assumes most of this potential is realised within about ten years.
英国 2022 年四天工作制试点中 61 家企业有 56 家在试点结束后继续实行: In Britain's 2022 four-day week trial, 56 of 61 firms kept it after the trial ended, showing working hours can change. In the transformative scenario, income concentration from automation may push redistribution, though whether it happens is highly uncertain.
Grace 等（2024）调查中「所有职业可完全自动化」的 10% 概率时间为: In Grace et al. (2024) the 10% date for "full automation of all occupations" is 2037 and the 50% date 2116. The transformative scenario greatly brings this forward, a low-probability, high-impact projection.
AI Index 2026：2025 年全球企业 AI 投资约 5817 亿美元: AI Index 2026: global corporate AI investment was about US$581.7 billion in 2025, up about 130%, but macro productivity evidence is still "early and inconsistent", and investment is highly concentrated in a few countries, firms and deals. Acemoglu (2024) estimates limited productivity gains from AI within ten years.
2026 年 5 月 7 日欧盟机构就推迟高风险义务达成临时协议，欧洲议会于 6: On 7 May 2026 EU institutions reached a provisional deal to delay high-risk obligations, and the European Parliament approved it on 16 June, pending formal Council adoption. The timetable may still change.
欧盟《人工智能法》已立法并分阶段实施；《国际 AI 安全报告 2026》指出能力: The EU AI Act is law and is being phased in. The International AI Safety Report 2026 notes capability is advancing faster than safety measures and scientific evidence.
《国际 AI 安全报告》由 100 多名专家撰写、多国政府支持，2026 年版强: The International AI Safety Report is written by over 100 experts and backed by many governments. Its 2026 edition stresses that capability is outpacing safety, giving a scientific basis for international coordination. Whether a binding deal forms depends on relations between the great powers.
SIPRI：2025 年全球军费约 2.89 万亿美元、连续第 11 年增长；《: SIPRI: global military spending of about US$2.89 trillion in 2025, the 11th straight rise. The International AI Safety Report 2026 records AI being used for cyberattacks and other malicious purposes.
IFR/AI Index 2026：2024 年新装 54.2 万台，在役存量: IFR/AI Index 2026: 542,000 newly installed in 2024, with an operational stock of 4.664 million (4.282 million in 2023) and China at 54% of new installations. At stock growth of about 8–9% a year, it doubles in about 9–10 years.
Omdia 估计 2025 年全球人形机器人出货约 1.3 万台，中国企业领先；: Omdia estimates about 13,000 humanoid robots shipped worldwide in 2025, led by Chinese firms. Unitree says it delivered over 5,500 to end customers in 2025. The projection assumes shipments multiply each year.
摩根士丹利预测人形机器人在 2030 年代后期加速普及、2050 年在用约 10: Morgan Stanley forecasts humanoid robots spreading faster in the late 2030s with about a billion in use by 2050, mostly at work, with homes later.
摩根士丹利预测 2050 年全球在用人形机器人约 10 亿台、相关市场约 5 万: Morgan Stanley forecasts about a billion humanoid robots in use worldwide by 2050, with a related market of about US$5 trillion.
WHO 预测全球痴呆症患者将从 2021 年约 5700 万增至 2030 年约: The WHO projects people with dementia worldwide rising from about 57 million in 2021 to about 78 million in 2030, with care needs growing fast. South Korea, Japan, Germany and others lead the world in factory robot density, giving them an industrial base.
Waymo 2026 年上半年在美国 10 个城市每周约 50 万次付费出行，累: In the first half of 2026 Waymo ran about 500,000 paid trips a week in 10 US cities, with over 20 million in total. Baidu's Apollo Go peaked at over 300,000 weekly orders in the fourth quarter of 2025, with over 20 million trips worldwide by February 2026 in 26 cities, and is road testing in London.
无人驾驶出租车 2025-2026 年已在中美多个城市规模化运营，并向海湾地区和: In 2025–2026 driverless taxis operated at scale in many Chinese and US cities, and expanded to the Gulf and Europe.
Aurora Innovation 于 2025 年在美国得克萨斯州达拉斯至休斯: Aurora Innovation began commercial driverless truck operations on the Dallas–Houston route in Texas in 2025.
IEA《全球电动汽车展望 2026》：2025 年全球电动车销量超过 2000: IEA Global EV Outlook 2026: global sales passed 20 million in 2025, about 25% of new cars, about 55% in China and about 28% in Europe. The IEA expects about 23 million in 2026, about 28%.
亿航智能的 EH216-S 无人驾驶载人航空器于 2025 年获得中国民航局颁发: EHang's EH216-S pilotless passenger aircraft got an operating certificate from China's Civil Aviation Administration in 2025, allowing crewed sightseeing flights.
IBM 路线图计划 2029 年建成容错量子计算机「Starling」（200: IBM's roadmap plans its fault-tolerant quantum computer "Starling" by 2029 (200 logical qubits and 100 million quantum operations). Google's 2024 Willow chip first showed "below threshold" quantum error correction. Outsiders still doubt the timetable.
美国 NIST 于 2024 年 8 月发布首批三项后量子密码标准（FIPS 2: The US NIST released its first three post-quantum cryptography standards in August 2024 (FIPS 203/204/205), and draft NIST IR 8547 proposes deprecating quantum-vulnerable algorithms by 2030 and banning them by 2035.
国际电联已发布 IMT-2030（6G）框架，相关标准化和频谱工作以 2030: The ITU has published its IMT-2030 (6G) framework, with standards and spectrum work aimed at around 2030.
2026 年在轨星链卫星超过 1 万颗；国际电联估计 2025 年全球仍有约 2: Starlink satellites in orbit passed 10,000 in 2026. The ITU estimates about 2.2 billion people were still offline in 2025, with coverage and cost the main barriers.
国际电联《事实与数字 2025》：2025 年约 60 亿人上网，未上网人口从: ITU Facts and Figures 2025: about 6 billion people were online in 2025, and the offline population fell from about 2.3 billion in 2024 (revised) to about 2.2 billion.
中国国家药监局于 2026 年 3 月 13 日批准首个植入式脑机接口产品上市，: China's National Medical Products Administration approved the first implantable brain-computer interface product on 13 March 2026, for adults with quadriplegia from cervical spinal cord injury. Neuralink had 21 participants by January 2026.
目前获批的植入式产品仅用于严重瘫痪患者，消费化还面临安全、伦理和监管障碍，因此列: Implants approved so far are only for severe paralysis, and consumer use faces safety, ethical and regulatory barriers, so this is a low-probability projection.
司美格鲁肽专利自 2026 年起在印度、中国、加拿大、巴西等国陆续到期，印度仿制: Semaglutide patents expire from 2026 in India, China, Canada, Brazil and elsewhere, and Indian generics cost about ₹1,300–4,200 a month. The US FDA approved the oral small-molecule GLP-1 orforglipron on 1 April 2026. The WHO issued a global guideline on GLP-1 for obesity in December 2025 (a conditional recommendation). A KFF survey in November 2025 shows about 12% of US adults using them.
KFF 调查显示美国成年人当前使用 GLP-1 药物的比例从 2024 年 5: KFF surveys show US adults currently using GLP-1 drugs rising from about 6% in May 2024 to about 12% in November 2025. The WHO has added GLP-1 to its obesity guidelines. Whether obesity keeps falling across populations needs longer-term data.
默沙东与 Moderna 于 2026 年 8 月宣布 III 期 INTerp: In August 2026 Merck and Moderna announced that the Phase III INTerpath-001 trial (1,137 high-risk melanoma patients after surgery) met its primary endpoint of recurrence-free survival, the first positive Phase III result for an mRNA cancer therapy, with data going to regulators.
INTerpath-001 III 期阳性结果；此前的 IIb 期 KEYNOT: The positive Phase III INTerpath-001 result. Five-year follow-up of the earlier Phase IIb KEYNOTE-942 showed the combination cut the risk of recurrence or death by about 49%.
2025 年《新英格兰医学杂志》报道首例为单个患儿定制的体内碱基编辑疗法，用于治: In 2025 the New England Journal of Medicine reported the first in vivo base-editing therapy custom-made for a single child, treating CPS1 deficiency, taking only months from diagnosis to dose.
CRISPR 疗法 Casgevy 自 2023 年起获批治疗镰状细胞病和β地中: The CRISPR therapy Casgevy has been approved for sickle cell disease and beta thalassaemia since 2023, extended to ages 2 and up in the US in July 2026, and in vivo base editing was first used for personalised treatment in 2025. Moving from rare to common diseases needs stronger safety evidence, so the probability is moderate.
美国 FDA 于 2023 年完全批准仑卡奈单抗、2024 年批准多奈单抗，20: The US FDA gave full approval to lecanemab in 2023 and approved donanemab in 2024, and in 2025 the first blood test to aid diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease. The WHO estimates about 57 million people had dementia worldwide in 2021, with nearly 10 million new cases a year.
WHO 2021 年全球痴呆症报告预测 2030 年约 7800 万、2050: The WHO's 2021 global dementia report projects about 78 million in 2030 and about 139 million in 2050. The WHO calls dementia the seventh leading cause of death worldwide.
现有抗淀粉样蛋白药物只能延缓病程；血液检测使大规模症状前筛查和干预成为可能，是研: Current anti-amyloid drugs only slow the disease. Blood tests make mass pre-symptom screening and intervention possible, and this is the main direction of research.
2024 年 3 月美国麻省总医院完成全球首例将基因编辑猪肾移植给在世患者的手术: In March 2024 Massachusetts General Hospital performed the world's first transplant of a gene-edited pig kidney into a living patient, and more xenotransplants have since entered clinical research.
TAME 试验旨在检验二甲双胍能否延缓多种衰老相关疾病，以推动将衰老作为药物靶点: The TAME trial aims to test whether metformin can delay many ageing-related diseases, to make ageing a drug target, and XPRIZE has a US$101 million "Healthspan" prize. No drug has yet been approved with ageing as its indication.
基于 mRNA 肿瘤疫苗、阿尔茨海默病早筛和衰老干预研究等现有进展的长期推演，不: A long-term projection based on current progress in mRNA cancer vaccines, early Alzheimer's screening and anti-ageing research, with very high uncertainty.
截至 2026 年，新加坡、美国、以色列、澳大利亚等国已批准若干款细胞培养肉或海: By 2026 Singapore, the US, Israel, Australia and others had approved some cultivated meat or seafood products, but none had reached sale at scale.
目前获批产品均未规模化，成本是主要障碍；价格持平需要技术与规模的大幅进步，属于低: No approved product has reached scale, and cost is the main barrier. Price parity needs great advances in technology and scale, so this is a low-probability projection.
WHO《世界疟疾报告 2025》：2024 年约 2.82 亿病例、61 万死亡: WHO World Malaria Report 2025: about 282 million cases and 610,000 deaths in 2024, with the African region at 94% of cases and 95% of deaths. Progress on cutting deaths is far off track, and antimalarial resistance is confirmed or suspected in at least 8 African countries.
WHO 已推荐 RTS,S 和 R21 两种疟疾疫苗，并在多个非洲国家推广（《世: The WHO has recommended two malaria vaccines, RTS,S and R21, now being rolled out in many African countries (World Malaria Report 2025).
《柳叶刀》疟疾消灭委员会（2019）认为在 2050 年前消灭疟疾「雄心勃勃但可: The Lancet Commission on Malaria Eradication (2019) holds that eradication by 2050 is "ambitious but achievable". By July 2025 the WHO had certified 47 countries and 1 territory malaria-free, with Georgia, Suriname and Timor-Leste all certified in 2025.
全球消灭脊灰行动（GPEI）战略已延长至 2029 年；野生 1 型脊灰病毒目前: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative's strategy has been extended to 2029. Wild type 1 polio is now endemic only in Pakistan and Afghanistan.
WHO 于 2025 年将来那帕韦纳入 HIV 预防指南；生产商与全球基金协议在: The WHO added lenacapavir to its HIV prevention guidelines in 2025. The maker and the Global Fund agreed to supply about 2 million people over three years, and the first doses reached Eswatini and Zambia in November 2025.
WHO：2024 年约 1070 万人患结核病、123 万人死亡；2023 年结: WHO: about 10.7 million people had tuberculosis in 2024 and 1.23 million died. TB research funding was about US$1.2 billion in 2023, far below the goal of US$5 billion a year.
GBD（《柳叶刀》2024）：2021 年细菌耐药直接导致约 114 万人死亡；: GBD (The Lancet, 2024): bacterial resistance directly caused about 1.14 million deaths in 2021. In the reference scenario direct deaths reach about 1.91 million and associated deaths about 8.22 million in 2050, with about 39 million direct deaths from 2025 to 2050. The World Bank estimates a high-resistance scenario may cut global GDP by 3.8% by 2050.
《柳叶刀》2024 年预测研究显示，革兰氏阴性菌新药研发情景可显著减少耐药死亡；: A 2024 Lancet forecast shows a scenario of new drugs for Gram-negative bacteria could greatly cut resistance deaths. The political declaration of the 2024 UN General Assembly high-level meeting on resistance sets a goal of cutting associated deaths 10% from 2019 by 2030.
WHO 成员国于 2025 年通过《大流行协定》，但开放签署取决于 PABS 附: WHO members adopted the Pandemic Agreement in 2025, but opening it for signature depends on the PABS annex. On 1 May 2026 the intergovernmental working group agreed to extend talks (subject to World Health Assembly approval), with results going to the 80th Assembly in 2027 or a special session in 2026.
H5N1 禽流感持续在动物中传播并造成散发人类病例（WHO 统计 2003 年至: H5N1 bird flu keeps spreading among animals and causing sporadic human cases (WHO counts 1,003 cases and 479 deaths worldwide from 2003 to September 2026), and the WHO assesses no sustained human-to-human spread so far. Broad-spectrum flu vaccines are still in development.
WHO 2025 年报告：超过 10 亿人患有精神健康问题，各国政府精神卫生支出: WHO 2025 report: over a billion people have mental health conditions, and median government mental health spending is only about 2% of health budgets. A 2025 Common Sense Media survey shows nearly three quarters of US teens have used AI companion apps.
澳大利亚社交媒体最低年龄规定于 2025 年 12 月 10 日生效；WHO 2: Australia's social media minimum age took effect on 10 December 2025. A 2025 WHO report shows loneliness highest among teens and young adults.

你可以随机降生，也可以自定义出生；在人生的关键时刻，可以选择给出的选项，也可以写: You can be born at random or customise your birth. At key moments you can pick from the options or write what you want to do. When AI is available, it weaves later storylines from each of your earlier choices, so new decisions grow out of your own past. When it isn't, the built-in engine still remembers your choices and lets them shape later life.

个人系数由健康值、家庭与收入位置、慢性病、吸烟等习惯组成，并经过归一化：全体人口: The personal factor combines health, family and income position, chronic illness and habits such as smoking, and is normalised so the population average is about 1. Simulated lifespans therefore match UN data. It is capped between 0.25 and 6 times.
2024 年及以前的生命表已经包含真实发生的危机死亡（如新冠疫情与战争），历史事: Life tables up to 2024 already include real crisis deaths (such as COVID-19 and wars), so historical events aren't counted again and only inform cause of death and story. From {0}, world line scenarios, random shocks and future events multiply in.
死因按世界卫生组织的年龄段 × 收入组死因构成抽取，并按处境调整：战乱提高暴力死: Cause of death is drawn from WHO data by age band and income group, then adjusted for your situation: war raises violent deaths, epidemics raise infectious disease, and smoking raises heart disease, cancer and respiratory illness.
收入 = 人均 GDP × 居民消费占比 ×（就业者约 1.5 倍）× 由基尼系: Income = GDP per capita × household consumption share × (about 1.5 for the employed) × your percentile position in a log-normal distribution set by the Gini coefficient. Unemployment risk comes from unemployment and youth unemployment rates; retirement age comes from each country's rules.
所有金额以 2021 年国际元（购买力平价、扣除通胀）计算，显示时按 2021: All amounts are calculated in 2021 international dollars (PPP, inflation-adjusted) and shown in local currency at 2021 prices. Savings and investments use real annual asset returns for 2000–2025 and are simulated by world line afterwards.
入学与升学概率来自中学与高等教育毛入学率，并受家庭条件、城乡、性别与时代影响；关: School and university odds come from secondary and tertiary gross enrolment, and are shaped by family, urban or rural life, sex and era. Key exams come from each country's system. Marriage odds are calibrated to median first-marriage age, and births to total fertility and mean age at childbearing.
迁徙只通过抉择、故事线与事件发生，可行性取决于你的钱、学历、目的地与常见的迁移路: Migration only happens through decisions, storylines and events. Whether it's possible depends on your money, education, destination and common routes.

It reads your situation, recent experience, past choices, your country's real numbers and that year's world events, so new decisions grow out of your own past.

The built-in engine has its own event library and storyline templates, so a whole life can be played without AI.
